referenceDna.annotatedDescription: The direct Reliance Autos website in London, England uses dark car-repair scene with white headline and green contact button. Navigation is minimal dark navigation with WhatsApp shortcut. Its page moves through garage-photo opening, trust summary, service menu, mechanic explanation, advice articles, location and contact, with services grouped into four problem-oriented categories. cars and working mechanics used between compact information blocks. Transferable mechanics are green contact control, four service groups, advice article rail. The brand identity, people, photographs, reviews, wording and business claims remain source-only.
